leadText:
A Guitarist (Japanese: ギタリスト Guitarist) is a type of Pokémon Trainer that debuted in Generation II games. They appear as young, blond men or (in Generation V only) black haired women, playing guitars.

They specialize in Pokémon, as they play s. They may also use Pokémon associated with sound waves, such as the evolutionary line in Generation III, and the / family in Generation IV and Generation VIII. They may have some relation to the class introduced in Generation I, and the class introduced in Generation V.

In Rocking the Virbank Gym! Parts 1 and 2, a Guitarist named Billy Jo appeared as a member of Roxie's rock band " and the Toxics".

In Battling at Full Volume!, a Guitarist named arrived at the camp of and with the intent of testing the strength of his , Spike, against Ash's Pikachu. Unbeknownst to him, however, the Trainer he battled was , who disguised herself as Ash to stand in for him after he had fallen ill.

A Guitarist briefly appears with his at the in Clobbering Claydol when was searching for .

==Trivia==
In , Guitarist Arturo can be found in these Pokémon Center locations around Sinnoh:
Sunday, Wednesday, Saturday: Pastoria City
Monday, Tuesday: Canalave City
Thursday, Friday: Sunyshore City
There is data in Pokémon Platinum for a battle with Guitarist Arturo with a level 7 , but it is completely inaccessible. 
From Generation II to Generation V, the type of guitar used by Guitarists is based on the well-known guitars of .
Many Guitarists found in various Battle Frontiers are likely references to famous real-life guitarists, including Iggy (Pop), Jimmie (Jimi Hendrix), and Les (Paul).
